text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Rai singer Boudjemaa Bechiri found dead on Friday; kidnapped by four gunmen on Wednesday night as he was leaving wedding party in eastern town of Constantine.
- Government holds national conference on economic and social strategy to seek support for its policy.
- President Zeroual to hold news conference, second since his election last year.
- Algeria's foreign debt estimated at less than $32 billion in 1996.
- Government of national union expected in coming days to oversee general and local elections next year.
